question: In order to celebrate earth's environment and raise public awareness about pollution, which of the following days is observed worldwide as Earth Day each year?
solution:
The correct answer is **22nd April**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Earth Day** is observed on **22nd April** each year.
 
• This day is celebrated worldwide to demonstrate support for environmental protection.
 
• The first Earth Day was celebrated on **April 22, 1970**.
 
• Earth Day events are coordinated globally by the **Earth Day Network**.
 
• Over **193 countries** participate in Earth Day activities each year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Year
 Milestone
 
 
 
 

 1970
 The first Earth Day was celebrated, leading to the creation of the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency.
 
 

 1990
 Earth Day went global, mobilizing 200 million people in 141 countries.
 
 

 2000
 Earth Day focused on global warming and clean energy, involving hundreds of millions of people.
 
 

 2010
 Earth Day's 40th anniversary, with a focus on climate action and environmental education.
 
 

 2020
 The 50th anniversary of Earth Day, with digital events due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
